candidate.name: Blockchain Capital
candidate.rationale: Materially distinct exact-source route after Kraken had no exact BCAP asset metadata and Ethereum exact-contract DEX discovery produced no exact pool. Blockchain Capital migrated BCAP fully to ZKsync, and RedStone/Securitize publicly document a BCAP-specific oracle feed on ZKsync. RedStone documents a public no-key HTTP API and historical price access. Physical qualification must independently prove BCAP symbol identity, timestamped observations, frozen-window availability/continuity, raw-response hashes and fail closed on unsupported symbol, stale/non-physical data or any identity ambiguity.
